items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: then he calls in all these pros, guys like Bill Watrous.

ctx.x: Manny Albam. Anyway, the band struggled for like two or three days to get the rhythm track down and then he calls in all these pros, guys like Bill Watrous. And the band is going, “How did they do that?” And he goes, “Well they play music.”

Yeah well the thing is there’s a lot of records of rock bands of the day — the Beatles played their own stuff of course, but there were some well known bands that were ghosted as they say. It was the Wrecking Crew in LA on a lot of pop and rock records that were supposed to be the band playing. I won’t tell you who, but you can find out. But
